per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  pps.title AS position_title,
  pps.team AS team,
  pps.person_name AS person_name,
  gm.name AS gm_name,
  gm.college_hall_of_fame_inductee AS gm_college_hof,
  gm.pro_hall_of_fame_inductee AS gm_pro_hof,
  draft_player1.name AS draft_higher_player,
  draft_player2.name AS draft_lower_player
FROM positions pps
JOIN general_managers gm ON gm.team = pps.team
JOIN drafts draft_player1 ON draft_player1.name = 'Steve Little'
JOIN drafts draft_player2 ON draft_player2.pick_number > draft_player1.pick_number
WHERE pps.title = 'Director of Player Personnel' 
  AND pps.team = 'Baltimore Ravens' 
  AND pps.person_name = 'Philip Savage'
LIMIT 1;

Who was the general manager of the Baltimore Ravens when Philip Savage served as Director of Player Personnel, and is this GM inducted into both the College Football Hall of Fame and the Pro Football Hall of Fame? Additionally, was Steve Little drafted higher than any player associated with that general manager's draft selections?
